title: Normalize legacy capability_required without silent recovery misrouting
mission: Close the routing gap exposed by Jose V12 G000003: repo-local jobs using the legacy singular capability_required field must not compile as capability-free. Normalize or migrate that legacy field into the supported capability model, preserve the intended requirement through recovery generations, and add regression coverage so a worker definitively lacking the required runtime capability skips before PIN CREATE.
definition_of_done: Inventory repo-local derived jobs that still use capability_required and classify each value against the current capability taxonomy without guessing.

For supported legacy values, normalize them deterministically into allocator-visible required_capabilities; for unsupported values, fail closed into explicit attention rather than silently emitting an empty requirement set.
portfolio-jose-v12-map-runtime-verification-v1 no longer reaches a worker that definitively lacks its real-browser runtime requirement.
Recovery generations preserve the same normalized capability requirements as ready/queue candidates.
Regression coverage includes a Jose-V12-like legacy singular field and proves preclaim skip occurs without consuming an authority CREATE attempt.
Efficiency Ratchet statically guards the alias/fail-closed behavior.
No product bytes, Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority are promoted.
